import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# Generate test data from known trapezoid parameters
rng = np.random.default_rng(23842359234598263956)
true_args = (0.3, 0.7, -1, 2)
x = stats.trapezoid(*true_args).rvs(1000, random_state=rng)

# Fit without starting values (uses defaults c=d=1 on buggy)
fitted_args = stats.trapezoid.fit(x)
fitted_c = fitted_args[0]
fitted_d = fitted_args[1]
fitted_loc = fitted_args[2]
fitted_scale = fitted_args[3]

# Compute log-likelihoods (negative log-likelihood for both)
true_llf = stats.trapezoid.nnlf(true_args, x)
fitted_llf = stats.trapezoid.nnlf(fitted_args, x)

# Record measurements
probe('fitted_c', fitted_c)
probe('fitted_d', fitted_d)
probe('fitted_loc', fitted_loc)
probe('fitted_scale', fitted_scale)
probe('true_nnlf', true_llf)
probe('fitted_nnlf', fitted_llf)
